title: Digital Divide Awakens
description: In the wake of the surge in digital currency euphoria, a significant portion of the population experiences exclusion from financial participation due to lack of access to technology. This sparks grassroots movements advocating for digital literacy and equitable internet access.
flavor: The whispers of disparity echo through community centers, igniting a passion for connectivity.
response_hint: Passing a law to fund technology access programs would significantly reduce social inequality.
